verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents first-party physics integration with Havok, Cannon.js, Ammo.js, and Oimo.js, plus built-in ray casting and mesh picking. However, physics comes through pluggable external engines rather than an explicitly built-in, zero-setup system, and one community commenter criticizes the physics implementation's correctness (an opinion, not a concrete failure report). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rigid bodies and collision handling, evidence that physics works out of the box without adding an engine plugin, and independent hands-on corroboration of physics quality.
